Hi Alicia — great to hear. Quick answers and next steps below; Ben and Camila are looped for ops and partner GTM specifics.

High-level:
- Registered leads: 10-month protection window by default; we can extend to 12 months for named-account exclusivity with a modest uplift to the commission rate.
- Commission waterfall (first-year ARR): 20% standard for registered leads, 12% for direct-sourced by Redwood, 8% referral (one-time credit). We can tier up to 25% for MAP-qualified strategic deals > $500k ARR.
- Registration: HubSpot partner portal is primary (fast adjudication). We also accept registration emails to partners@redwood.com when needed — portal has priority. Overlap adjudication uses earliest valid registration with sales activity proof.

Action items:
1) Ben: attach the commission calc workbook and a sample registration form.
2) Camila: outline onboarding steps and training credits for the pilot (2 enablement sessions).
3) Alicia: confirm whether the CFO needs contract redlines or a short-term MOU first.

I can draft a compact reseller addendum (1–2 pages) for quick signature if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa

Alicia — legal here. Quick clarifications and proposed minimal redlines:

1) Exclusivity: we can offer account-level exclusivity for 6–12 months contingent on a signed MOU that defines named accounts, minimum engagement activity, and performance thresholds. Exclusivity will be limited to Sagebird-registered accounts only.

2) Payment & commission timing: commissions paid quarterly, net-45 from Redwood invoice date; insist on a clawback window of 12 months if customers churn or credits are issued.

3) Data/branding: co-marketing allowed with Redwood brand guidelines; any joint case study requires prior sign-off.

Next steps: I can prepare a one-page reseller addendum plus an MOU template for exclusivity. Alicia — if that works, please confirm and we'll send the DocuSign envelope.
